Sleep Cycle App – Neumorphism Redesign

An unofficial January 2020 redesign of a sleep-tracking app, made while the trend was weeks old.

Source
Dribbble (archived copy)
Creator
Devanta Ebison
Made
2020 (posted 2 January 2020, per the Wayback copy of the shot page)
Style
Neumorphism (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Soft, calm, quiet
Evidence
Opened the shot’s image (dribbble__2x_4x.png, 1600 × 1200) from cdn.dribbble.com, found through the Wayback capture of 4 January 2020. The live Dribbble page returned an empty body to scripts.
Reviewed
28 September 2026
Rights
Link and metadata only. License: unverified. Rights policy

Context

The designer wrote: “Wanted to try my hand at this new design style called neumorphism because it’s been trending for the past few weeks. This was a fun exercise, but I don’t know if this style will stand the test of time.”

It is a fan concept. Sleep Cycle AB did not make it. The Wayback capture of 4 January 2020 shows 32,152 views and 334 likes.

Observed

  • Three tilted phones on a very pale gray-blue background. The phone bodies, buttons, and tabs are the same color as the background and are shaped by white highlights and soft gray shadows.
  • The clock display “10:00” sits in a pressed rectangular well; the HR and MIN buttons are raised circles.
  • The segmented control (Days, Weeks, Months) is a pressed track with a raised pill for the selected item. The chart bars are coral fills inside pressed tracks.
  • One accent color, a soft coral, fills the “Set alarm” button, the chart bars, the progress rings, and the active tab icon.
  • Text is a rounded geometric sans-serif in slate gray, bold for figures.

Why it belongs

A textbook statement of the style two months after Plyuto’s shot: the object details are gone, only surface, shadow, and one accent remain. The designer’s own doubt about its future is an early sign of the reaction against it.

Borrow

Draw bar-chart tracks as pressed wells and fill them with the accent, so the empty part of each bar stays readable without gridlines.
